# awscc_smsvoice_registration_attachment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SMSVOICE::RegistrationAttachment



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `attachment_body` (String) The registration file to upload. The maximum file size is 1500KB and valid file extensions are PDF, JPEG and PNG.
- `attachment_url` (String) A URL to the required registration file. For example, the URL to an MMS/shortcode form.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of tags (key and value pairs) to associate with the registration attachment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `attachment_status` (String) The status of the registration attachment.
- `created_timestamp` (String) The time when the registration attachment was created, in UNIX epoch time format.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `registration_attachment_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the registration attachment.
- `registration_attachment_id` (String) The unique identifier for the registration attachment.
- `uploaded_attachment_url` (String) The URL to the document that was uploaded as the registration attachment, as returned by the service.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key identifier, or name, of the tag.
- `value` (String) The string value associated with the key of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_smsvoice_registration_attachment.example
  identity = {
    registration_attachment_arn = "registration_attachment_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `registration_attachment_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the registration attachment

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_smsvoice_registration_attachment.example
  id = "registration_attachment_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_smsvoice_registration_attachment.example "registration_attachment_arn"
```
